rules.description: A player could not place the thing again where it stands with its neighbours present (check_replaceable's rule): a vent with nothing behind it, a battery with no frame below, a thing no kit builds.
rules.message: {display_name} ({prefab} {reference_id}): a player could not place it again where it stands ({p.rule ?? "other"}): {p.reason}.

rules.description: A cable, pipe or chute piece (or what stands in its slot) in a door's keep-out: the door's face and the configured band either side.
rules.message: {prefab} {reference_id} stands in the keep-out of door {door?.reference_id}.

rules.description: A device port whose joining cell lies in a door's keep-out.
rules.message: {device.display_name} ({device.reference_id}) port {index} ({type}) joins in the keep-out of door {joining_cell.keepout_door?.reference_id}.

rules.description: A port's joining cell holds a piece of its kind that does not join it (another network's), so nothing can.
rules.message: {device.display_name} ({device.reference_id}) port {index} ({type}): its joining cell holds {occupant?.prefab} {occupant?.reference_id}, which does not join it, so nothing can.

rules.description: A cable, pipe or chute piece, or an in-line tank (the small and big tanks that sit in a pipe run), with a cell in air: on no frame and no wall plane. The game lets these stand in air; the house rule wants them on a frame or a plate. Passive vents are not checked.
rules.message: {prefab} {reference_id} floats in air ({air} of {count(cells)} cells on no frame and no wall plane).

rules.description: A cable, pipe or chute piece on a window's face.
rules.message: {prefab} {reference_id} runs across the face of window {window?.reference_id}.

rules.description: Two devices whose mesh boxes run more than 0.1 m into each other, or one inside the other (a sensor under a console's overhang). Flush neighbours only touch or overlap by a rim; things sharing a cell (a device on a pipe) are skipped.
rules.message: {a.display_name} ({a.reference_id}) and {b.display_name} ({b.reference_id}) {if(is_infinite(depth), "overlap: one lies inside the other", "run " + format(depth, "0.00") + " m into each other")}.

rules.description: A face-mounted device whose back is in a room and whose front is not: it faces out of the room behind it.
rules.assert: not has(mounted) or has(mounted.front.room) or not has(mounted.back.room)
rules.message: {display_name} ({prefab} {reference_id}) faces {mounted?.outward}, out of the room behind it.

rules.description: A face-mounted device whose mesh rectangle spans more than one 2 m wall section by more than 0.1 m, though neither side is wider than 2.2 m, so a shift would put it on one.
rules.message: {display_name} ({prefab} {reference_id}) spans {seam_sections(x)} wall sections on {mounted?.plane}.

rules.description: The side of a device carrying its slots, buttons and switches faces another device, a chute or small thing, a frame's body, or a wall or frame on the plane right in front of it. Only information where no control sits clearly on one side (the device's forward stands in).
rules.message: {display_name} ({prefab} {reference_id}): the side its controls face, {c?.side} ({c?.source}), has {blocked} right in front of it.

rules.description: A cable, pipe or chute piece hugging a door's jamb, just outside its keep-out. Doors in floors or ceilings have no jambs.
rules.message: {prefab} {reference_id} runs along the jamb of door {door?.reference_id} ({door?.display_name}).

rules.description: A console, computer, display, dial, button, switch, lever or keypad not mounted on a wall.
rules.select: devices where has(rotation) and count(cells) > 0 and any(["Console", "Computer", "LogicDisplay", "Dial", "Button", "Switch", "Lever", "Keypad"], w => contains(prefab, w))
rules.message: {display_name} ({prefab} {reference_id}) has controls and is not mounted on a wall.

rules.description: check_replaceable's rule could not be asked of the thing (no placement cursor for its prefab).
rules.message: {display_name} ({prefab} {reference_id}): not checked: {trim_end(p.reason, ".")}.

replaceable().reason: no placement cursor for the prefab.

rules.description: A solar panel storms reach must be a Reinforced variant. While a storm with a damage multiplier runs (Mars dust, Europa snow, Vulcan ash, Venus 1; Vulcan fire storm 3), each panel exposed to the planet's air takes a 10% chance every 0.5 s of losing 0.5% of its health times its WeatherDamageScale and the multiplier (SolarRadiators); a panel whose WeatherDamageScale is 0 takes none, as the Reinforced panels.
rules.assert: contains(prefab, "Reinforced") or weather_damage_scale <= 0 or not weather_exposed(x)
rules.message: {display_name} ({prefab} {reference_id}) is exposed to storms and is not a Reinforced panel: each storm wears it down (SolarRadiators, WeatherDamageScale).

rules.description: A cable lighter than its network's heaviest cable burns first once the power through it passes its rating (the power tick burns a random cable whose rating is below min(supply, demand)). Fine while that power fits the weakest cable.
rules.message: {prefab} {reference_id} is {grade} cable ({max_power} W), lighter than network {n?.id}'s heaviest ({n?.max_cable_power} W), while the power through the network ({format(flow, "0")} W) is more than its weakest cable carries ({n?.min_cable_power} W): the power tick burns a cable rated below that flow.

rules.description: A device whose prefab a chip on its data network batches by name (lbn, sbn, batch_write_name) must carry one of the names it uses: a solar tracker panel named for its chip. Batches by name reach only devices whose name hashes to the one given.

let.batches: flat_map(filter(networks, n => n.kind == "cable"), n => filter(chip_batch_names(n), b => has(b.name_hash) and b.prefab_hash == x.prefab_hash))

rules.assert: count(batches) == 0 or any(batches, b => b.name_hash == x.name_hash)
rules.message: {display_name} ({prefab} {reference_id}): chips on its data network batch {prefab} by name ({join(distinct(map(batches, b => b.name ?? str(b.name_hash))))}) and its name is none of them, so they never reach it.

rules.description: Nothing (a structure or the terrain) stands between a solar panel and the sun along the day's path, while the sun is more than 10 degrees up, as the panel's own raycasts see it.
rules.message: {display_name} ({prefab} {reference_id}) is shaded for part of the day: something stands between it and the sun's path.

rules.description: A filtration unit pushes into both outputs with no back-pressure check (FiltrationMachineBase: it adds the filtered gas to Output and dumps the rest into Output2), so each output network needs a tank or regulator to take it, and a chip on its data network should switch it On and off.

let.outs: filter(ports, p => p.role in ["Output", "Output2"] and has(p.network))
let.open: filter(outs, p => not any((p.network?.devices ?? []) + (p.network?.members ?? []), d => contains(d.prefab, "Tank") or d.flow == "regulator"))

rules.message: {display_name} ({prefab} {reference_id}) pushes with no back-pressure check: {if(count(open) > 0, "no tank or regulator on output network " + join(map(open, p => p.network?.id ?? 0)), "")}{if(count(open) > 0 and not switched, "; ", "")}{if(switched, "", "no chip on its data network writes its On")}.

rules.description: An outdoor vent (active or passive) whose pipe network, or any network upstream of it through pumps, valves, regulators, filters and mixers, holds oxygen, nitrous oxide or ozone.
rules.select: things where outdoors and ("ActiveVent" in runtime_types or "PassiveVent" in runtime_types)

let.holding: flat_map(filter(networks, n => n.kind == "pipe"), n => filter(upstream(n) + [n], u => mol_of(u.gases, oxidisers) > 0))

rules.message: {display_name} ({prefab} {reference_id}) vents outdoors and network {join(map(distinct(holding), u => u.id))} feeding it holds oxidiser ({format(sum(distinct(holding), u => mol_of(u.gases, oxidisers)), "0.###")} mol).

rules.description: A pipe network holding both fuel (over 1 mol) and oxidiser must stay below its auto-ignition temperature (GasMixture.IsAutoIgnition: methane and hydrogen 573.15 K, alcohol 673.15 K, 250 K lower with nitrous oxide, 150 K with ozone; hydrazine at its critical temperature), or it burns by itself.
rules.select: networks where kind == "pipe" and any(keys(gases), g => is_fuel(g) and gases[g] > 1) and any(keys(gases), g => is_oxidiser(g) and gases[g] > 0.00001)
rules.message: Pipe network {id} holds fuel and oxidiser at {format(temperature ?? 0, "0.#")} K, above its auto-ignition temperature of {format(limit ?? 0, "0.#")} K: it burns.

rules.description: An outdoor liquid pipe must be insulated, or its network warmer than the freezing point of everything it holds: frozen content damages the network's weakest pipe.
rules.select: pieces where kind == "pipe" and content == "liquid" and outdoors
rules.assert: insulated or (has(network) and all(filter(keys(network.gases), g => network.gases[g] > 0.00001), g => (network.temperature ?? 0) > (freezing_point(g) ?? 0)))
rules.message: {prefab} {reference_id} carries liquid outdoors uninsulated, and network {network?.id} at {format(network?.temperature ?? 0, "0.#")} K is at or below a freezing point of what it holds.

rules.description: Nothing that fills a 2 m cell (a frame, or another structure with BlockGrid collision) may stand in a deep miner's drill column, from the cell below it down to y 0: the drill stops there with 'something in the way' (DeepMiner.CheckThingInWay). Walls, floors, pipes, cables and small devices do not stop it.
rules.message: {display_name} ({prefab} {reference_id}): {first(blocking)?.blocker?.prefab} {first(blocking)?.blocker?.reference_id} stands in its drill column at {first(blocking)?.position}.

rules.description: Every cell of a cable lies inside a frame or on a frame's face: no stretch through air or along a bare wall.
rules.message: {prefab} {reference_id} has {count(off)} of {count(cells)} cells off the frames ({join(distinct(map(off, c => c.support)))}).
